"""MongoEngine documents written by Model2DB from Order. Review them before using them."""

import enum

import mongoengine as me


class OrderStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PAID = "paid"
    SHIPPED = "shipped"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class Customer(me.EmbeddedDocument):
    id = me.FloatField(required=True)
    email = me.StringField(required=True)
    fullName = me.StringField(required=True, db_field="full_name")
    phone = me.StringField()
    shippingAddress = me.EmbeddedDocumentField("Address", required=True, db_field="shipping_address")
    createdAt = me.DateTimeField(required=True, db_field="created_at")


class Address(me.EmbeddedDocument):
    street = me.StringField(required=True)
    city = me.StringField(required=True)
    postalCode = me.StringField(required=True, db_field="postal_code")
    country = me.StringField(required=True)


class OrderLine(me.EmbeddedDocument):
    product = me.ReferenceField("Product", required=True)
    quantity = me.FloatField(required=True)
    unitPrice = me.FloatField(required=True, db_field="unit_price")


class Order(me.Document):
    id = me.FloatField(primary_key=True)
    customer = me.EmbeddedDocumentField("Customer", required=True)
    status = me.EnumField(OrderStatus, required=True)
    lines = me.ListField(me.EmbeddedDocumentField("OrderLine"))
    couponCode = me.StringField(db_field="coupon_code")
    tags = me.ListField(me.StringField())
    placedAt = me.DateTimeField(required=True, db_field="placed_at")

    meta = {"collection": "order", "indexes": [{"fields": ["lines.product"], "name": "ix_order_lines_product"}]}


class Product(me.Document):
    id = me.FloatField(primary_key=True)
    sku = me.StringField(required=True, unique=True)
    name = me.StringField(required=True)
    price = me.FloatField(required=True)
    categories = me.ListField(me.ReferenceField("Category"))
    attributes = me.DictField(me.StringField(), required=True)

    meta = {"collection": "product"}


class Category(me.Document):
    id = me.FloatField(primary_key=True)
    name = me.StringField(required=True)
    products = me.ListField(me.ReferenceField("Product"))

    meta = {"collection": "category"}

"""Beanie documents written by Model2DB from Order. Pass the Document classes to init_beanie(). Review them before using them."""

import datetime
import enum

from beanie import Document, Link
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pymongo import ASCENDING, IndexModel


class OrderStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PAID = "paid"
    SHIPPED = "shipped"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class Customer(BaseModel):
    id: float
    email: str
    fullName: str = Field(alias="full_name")
    phone: str | None = Field(default=None)
    shippingAddress: "Address" = Field(alias="shipping_address")
    createdAt: datetime.datetime = Field(alias="created_at")


class Address(BaseModel):
    street: str
    city: str
    postalCode: str = Field(alias="postal_code")
    country: str


class OrderLine(BaseModel):
    product: "Link[Product]"
    quantity: float
    unitPrice: float = Field(alias="unit_price")


class Order(Document):
    id: float = Field(alias="_id")
    customer: "Customer"
    status: OrderStatus
    lines: "list[OrderLine]" = Field(default_factory=list)
    couponCode: str | None = Field(default=None, alias="coupon_code")
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    placedAt: datetime.datetime = Field(alias="placed_at")

    class Settings:
        name = "order"
        indexes = [IndexModel([("customer.email", ASCENDING)], name="uq_order_customer_email", unique=True), IndexModel([("lines.product", ASCENDING)], name="ix_order_lines_product")]


class Product(Document):
    id: float = Field(alias="_id")
    sku: str
    name: str
    price: float
    categories: "list[Link[Category]]" = Field(default_factory=list)
    attributes: dict[str, str]

    class Settings:
        name = "product"
        indexes = [IndexModel([("sku", ASCENDING)], name="uq_product_sku", unique=True)]


class Category(Document):
    id: float = Field(alias="_id")
    name: str
    products: "list[Link[Product]]" = Field(default_factory=list)

    class Settings:
        name = "category"
